# Zodiak DS — Templates API Reference

> Sources: `Shared/DesignSystem/Templates/` · `docs/zodiak-pdf/Overview - Layout grid.md`

---

## Template Selection Guide

| Template | When to use |
|---|---|
| `ZodiakActivityTemplate` | Standard feature screen — scrollable content, optional eyebrow/intro |
| `ZodiakListTemplate` | Feature screen that displays a list — built-in empty state |
| `ZodiakInputOutputTemplate` | Feature screen with inputs + pinned submit button at bottom |
| `ZodiakAdaptiveTemplate` | Same as ActivityTemplate but always centers content (iPad-first) |
| `ZodiakLayoutGrid` | Adaptive column grid within a template's content slot |

<rules>
**Rule: Template is ALWAYS the screen root in `Features/`. Never raw `ScrollView`.**
</rules>
